family: log ROS = intercept + nonnegative wind coefficient * log1p(midflame km/h) + nonpositive moisture coefficient * dead moisture / 10
objective: equal-burn-day mean squared log error, intercept unpenalized
selection: inner leave-one-burn-day-out equal-day MAE; outer leave-one-burn-day-out evaluation
deploymentGuard: fuel 1 only; finite inputs inside training wind and moisture ranges; explicit experimental opt-in
limitations: Previously inspected single-site Australian data; nested resampling is retrospective internal evaluation, not new external validation. No post-evaluation family revision.
